resources.string: A tool for writing stories and the worlds they live in.
Free, open source, local first, and always respects your privacy.
Break your story into scenes and gather them into chapters. Changed your mind about the order? Drag them around until it clicks.

Keep an encyclopedia of your people, places and things, with notes and timelines alongside. Your scenes will detect references to entries in your encyclopedia so you will always know who turns up where.
Projects are plain text files in ordinary folders on your own disk. Hammer works offline, and you can open, copy or back them up however you like. No lock-in.
Hammer runs on Android, desktop and iOS. Turn on sync if you like, and pick up on your phone where you left off on your laptop.
We set up Alice in Wonderland as an example project. Poke around in it to see how everything fits together, then start one of your own.
